senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; יֹפִי; v. יָפֶה)fine build, beauty; propriety Taan. 31ᵃ (the fair maiden said) תנו עיניכם לי׳ ed. (Ms. M. בי׳) put your eyes on (give your choice to) beauty.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 45b">Succ. 45ᵇ</cite> Ms. M. (ed. in Mish., <cite ref="Sukkah 45a:2">ib. 45ᵃ</cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) <he>י׳ לך מזבח</he> thine, altar, is the beauty (of forgiveness).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 25:8">Ex. R. s. 25</cite> <he>אני מראה לך י׳ פנים אל פנים</he> I shall let thee see the beauty of a revelation of face to face (as granted to Moses).
<cite ref="Yoma 54b:6">Yoma 54ᵇ</cite> <he>מוכלל</he> (<he>יָפְיוֹ</he>) <he>יוֹפְיוֹ של וכ׳</he> the perfection of the beauty (harmony) of the universe.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 49b:5">Kidd. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>עשרה קבים י׳ וכ׳</he> ten measures of beauty have come down to the world, nine of which Jerusalem has taken; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:15">Esth. R. to I, 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 87a:9">B. Mets. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>וחזר י׳ למקומו</he> and (her) beauty came back again; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 6:6">Peah VI, 6</cite> <he>י׳ כח</he>, v. <cite ref="J00500"><he>יָפֶה</he></cite>.
